headline.text: L2 blade work kept the line down *90 minutes* through mid-shift — now running steady after shimming and tension adjustments.

per_plant_summary.L1: Four lines ran caramel with multiple brief stoppages resolved inside the shift. S4 kettle air leak fixed by 07:55, S1 separating table belt back up at 07:15, and S1 pump reset at 09:22. Pallet wrapper capacity flagged — 22 unwrapped pallets at 12:51 with only 2 wrappers for 4 lines and rework. S4 chiller malfunctioning as of 13:17.
per_plant_summary.L2: ML2 finished FW changeover and ran caramel by 09:08. Blade spacer replacement kept the line down from 10:47 to 10:58, then pieces weren't separating cleanly — maintenance shimmed and adjusted tension through 11:48. ML3 replaced a belt during CIL and was back running at 12:12. Line stopped at 13:13 to clear accumulation.
per_plant_summary.L3: Truffle line wire mesh broke overnight — operator trimmed loose wire to keep running but issue persists. ML1 C1 conveyor stopped repeatedly through the shift, buffer dropped to 12%, line paused 30 minutes at 09:34 to recover. ML4 cleared laser code accumulation and ran steady after 12:58.

notes.text: Maintenance replaced metal detector lock with keyed version at 12:54 on S3.
Grid table for ML1 bar melting was located in off-site trailer and is being retrieved.

resolved.title: S4 kettle won't send caramel to cook
resolved.summary: Manual and automatic send both failed at 06:27 — kettle wouldn't start cooking.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 07:55 — Marcos and Lolo found air leak around kettle lid, tightened it, 'we are cooking again'.

resolved.title: S1 separating table belt stopped
resolved.summary: Belt not working at 06:58, line waiting on maintenance.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 07:15 — 'The belt is already running; we are starting the line up again' (Victor Romero Sr.).

resolved.title: S1 hopper level low, pump not starting
resolved.summary: Hopper level dropped at 09:15, pump failed to start automatically.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 09:22 — 'we reset the system, and we are running now' (Marcos Jimenez).

resolved.title: ML2 blade spacer replacement
resolved.summary: Line down at 10:47 for maintenance to replace spacers to the blades.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 10:58 — 'Line is back up' (Alex Mendoza).

resolved.title: ML2 FW changeover in progress
resolved.summary: Maintenance working FW changeover from 05:35, depositing chocolate only while waiting.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 09:08 — print dialed in, aligners adjusted, 'Long belts and FW dialed in. We are depositing with caramel' (Alex Mendoza).

resolved.title: ML2 pieces not separating when cutting
resolved.summary: Many pieces not separating cleanly at 11:09, maintenance adjusting blade tension and shimming.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 11:48 — 'Line is running' (Jeffrey Barney) after shimming and tension adjustments completed.

resolved.title: ML3 belt replacement during CIL
resolved.summary: Line stopped at 11:39 for CIL, maintenance replacing a belt.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 12:12 — swab tests satisfactory, 'The line is running' (Molding Line 3 Pack).

resolved.title: ML4 laser code issue causing accumulation
resolved.summary: Laser code problem created heavy accumulation at 12:53, crew working to clear.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 12:58 — 'Line has been running steady on WDS' (Itzel Chavez).

needs_attention.title: Pallet wrapper capacity insufficient for 4 lines
needs_attention.summary: 22 unwrapped pallets on S1 at 12:51 — only 2 wrappers for 4 running lines plus rework, cannot keep up.
needs_attention.status: Curt committed at 13:19 to walk tomorrow and see where a third wrapper can be added.

needs_attention.title: S4 belts 7 short and long 8 swapped
needs_attention.summary: Belts swapped at 13:07, causing caramel issues — operator making adjustments to work around.
needs_attention.status: Operator adjusting at 13:07 to see if line can work around it for now.

needs_attention.title: S4 chiller malfunctioning
needs_attention.summary: Chiller not working properly at 13:17, maintenance notified.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance notified at 13:17, no update in window.

needs_attention.title: ADP time clock showing connection error since Friday
needs_attention.summary: Left ADP time clock in break room has connection error, down since Friday 10/25.
needs_attention.status: Flagged at 07:13, no update in window.

needs_attention.title: S4 rails not staying in place

needs_attention.status: Maintenance helping adjust at 13:01, coaching requested for operators not to adjust rails during cleans.

needs_attention.title: Pallet wrap constantly breaking and tearing

needs_attention.status: Maintenance looking at the wrapper as of 13:03, no resolution yet.

needs_attention.title: ML2 line down to clear accumulation
needs_attention.summary: Line stopped at 13:13 to clear up accumulation.
needs_attention.status: Line down as of 13:13 to clear accumulation, no restart message in window.

needs_attention.status: Maintenance initially holding off at 05:19, operator removed loose wire to improve operation at 05:37, but no permanent fix in window.

needs_attention.title: ML1 C1 conveyor stopping repeatedly

needs_attention.status: Maintenance notified at 06:55 and again at 08:01 when belt moved north. Buffer dropped to 12%, line paused 30 min at 09:34 to recover. C6 belt reported centered and running well at 12:19, but no clear C1 resolution.

needs_attention.summary: M3 and M4 belts moved at 07:24 — maintenance had already adjusted but they shifted again.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance called at 07:24, no resolution posted in window.

needs_attention.summary: Pallet jack clearance issue with new coconut oil delivery at 08:50.
needs_attention.status: Flagged at 08:50, no resolution in window.
